messages:
maya-csm: Heads up — Nimbus QBR scheduled Tue 4/1. Onboarding flagged a big embeddings surge from a new cohort. Can we do a 15m triage and short preflight for cost guardrails? :eyes:
owen-finops: Yep saw that spike in the nightly job. Quick numbers: avg tokens/day jumped from ~2k -> ~42k for the onboarding group. If sustained, projected monthly spend +~$6.5k. Suggest temporary soft-cap + alerting. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
liam-embed-ops: We can implement a soft throttle and prefix-KV caching for their top prompts. Two options: 1) per-account daily embed cap + warning, 2) adaptive batching to cut cost 25%. Prefer #2 longer term but need #1 for the QBR immediate safety net.
sarah-qa: If we add a cap, I can run a quick regression test matrix against the ingest path and the real-time embed flow. Need a spec for expected error codes/headers.
maya-csm: Proposed mitigation: set alerts at 50/80/95% of a provisional daily cap (50k), auto-notify CSM + FinOps, and soft-throttle at 90% with one-touch override. I'll add to the enablement checklist and tell Nimbus we're implementing guardrails.
owen-finops: Draft alert config below — can someone confirm engineerable?
``` 
budget_alerts:
  thresholds_pct: [50, 80, 90]
  notify: ["maya-csm", "owen-finops"]
  soft_throttle_at_pct: 90
  daily_embed_cap: 50000
  escalation: "pager to eng-oncall if >120% for 3 hrs"
```
liam-embed-ops: That fits. We can support soft_throttle via a header and return 429 with body {"reason":"soft_throttle","estimate":...}. We'll add a feature flag and rollout to dedicated routing for Nimbus first.
costbot: Alert policy created: nimbus-embed-spike-1807777777. Notifications wired to #customer-success and email to owen-finops.
nora-customer: Thanks — really appreciate the proactive guardrail. We'll prepare a short list of top 10 prompts and expected throughput. Also, minor ask: can batching be turned on for the batch-embedding endpoint? That would help smoothing costs.
maya-csm: Great — Liam + Sarah, can you sync and put a short testing checklist in the shared QBR doc? I'll include a slide with the spend forecast, mitigation steps, and the enablement actions (doc link: https://redwood.internal/qbrs/nimbus). Owen — can you add the conservative spend projection table and the renewal risk note?
owen-finops: On it. I'll paste the conservative projection into the doc and flag the renewal risk as "watch — medium" given high onboarding usage but healthy MRR. Will follow up after triage.
maya-csm: Thanks team — aiming to close this before end of week so QBR has the mitigation slide. :thumbsup:
